title: error data
description: Emitted when a command fails or an internal error occurs.

reason.description: Present on some errors to tell apart failures that share a code. storage_open_failed from open_storage and submit_passphrase carries wrong_passphrase, passphrase_required (no passphrase was given), corrupt_metadata, insecure_permissions (the database file is open to other users and its mode cannot be restricted), unsupported_format (the database was written by a newer version), in_use (another program, such as another daemon, the TUI or Bus, holds the database, and the open gave up after waiting 5 seconds), upgrade_failed or compact_failed (the database was written by an older version and could not be upgraded, or compacted after its upgrade, for example on a full disk or in a directory the daemon cannot write to; every open tries again), and none for other failures. send_message_failed carries connection_lost or message_too_large; see send_message.
